input.brief: Cameroon ice-cream cake shop: real cake photography, custom cake requests for store pickup, customers choose size, flavor and toppings; pickup date at least 48 hours ahead; local quote and deposit flow.

direction.name: The specimen catalogue
direction.idea: Present what is on offer the way a field guide presents birds: each item alone on a flat colour, same scale, same angle, named plainly. A bakery's pastries become specimens and the specimens become the menu. A furniture maker's chairs each get their own colour tile. The format flatters ordinary objects because it treats each as worth looking at, and it replaces both the feature grid and the product-card grid with something that has a point of view.
direction.composition: Hero: a left-aligned statement of what this is (5–7vw, upper-left) beside or above a tight cluster of four to seven specimen tiles of different sizes arranged as a loose mosaic that runs off the right edge. Each tile is a flat colour square or 4:5 rectangle with one photograph centred on it, no border, 8–12px gaps. The main section is the catalogue itself: a grid of tiles in which each item has its name and one fact set beneath the tile in the text face, aligned left to the tile edge. Tile colours rotate through three or four fields from the palette. One tile in every six or seven is double size. Supporting sections (about, how to order) are plain text on the ground colour, kept short.
direction.typography: Friendly and plain. Item names at 18–22px in medium weight, facts beneath in the soft ink. One big statement in the hero; no other display type.
direction.colour: The tiles are the colour: three or four flat fields from the palette, repeated in a steady rotation. Ground stays neutral.
direction.imagery: Photographs of single items on plain backgrounds, all cropped to sit at the same apparent size within their tile. On light tiles, `mix-blend-mode: multiply` removes white studio backgrounds. If the subject's own item photographs are missing, use the dealt set and say so.
direction.richness: Rhythm of colour tiles and the pleasure of comparing like with like.
direction.pitfalls: It needs at least six items that can be shown as objects; with three it is a feature row. Keep labels outside the tiles. No shadows under the objects, no hover lift.

hero.name: Statement beside specimen mosaic
hero.blueprint: The viewport is split 50/50 by tone alone: the left half is the page ground, the right half a field one step darker, meeting at a clean vertical edge with no line. Left half: the wordmark at 22px sits top-left on a 32px margin; under it the statement at clamp(44px, 4.4vw, 68px), bold, tracking -0.04em, leading 1.0, top-left aligned and filling the upper 40% of the half. The lower part of this side stays empty except for one supporting sentence at 18px pinned bottom-left and the single action as a solid rectangle beside it. Right half: a loose mosaic of seven specimen tiles on a 4-column, 3-row grid with 14px gaps. Each tile is a flat palette colour at 3:4 holding one cut-out item, centred, object-fit: contain, mix-blend-mode: multiply. Five cells are left empty so the tiles stagger; one tile spans two columns and two rows; the rightmost column is cropped by the viewport edge. Two text links sit top-right over the darker field. The right half may be position: sticky while the left scrolls.
hero.mobile: The split becomes a stack. The statement comes first at 10.5vw on two lines inside 20px margins, the supporting sentence under it at 16px, then the action. Below, the darker field runs full width and the mosaic becomes two columns of tiles, the right column started 48px lower than the left; five tiles show and the last row is cropped by the bottom of the screen. Navigation is the wordmark and one link.
hero.headline: A 3-5 word statement of what is on offer, at most 28 characters so it holds two lines at 10.5vw on a phone.

motion.name: Shutter image
motion.description: The one hero or showcase image opens from an edge with a clip-path over about 1.1 seconds while the picture inside settles from 1.12 scale to rest. Use it once, on the image that matters most; later images simply are there. Recipe: 'Image shutter' in references/motion.md.

sections.name: Dense masonry sheet
sections.blueprint: A three-line statement at 22px, 30ch wide, sits at the 66% column with 64px of space below it; it is the only large text. Then a dense masonry of about twenty tiles in six columns with 4px gaps and 12px outer margins, built with CSS `columns: 6; column-gap: 4px` and `break-inside: avoid` on each figure. Tile sizes range from 90px squares to one feature tile of 280 by 160px that sits above the first two columns, outside the column flow. Images keep their natural ratios, so column bottoms are ragged. Every tile has one caption line at 12px directly beneath, 6px below the image and 14px above the next tile, in the form name, comma, type. Mix photographs, posters, details and textures. No hover chrome; the sheet reads at a glance and fills the full width.
sections.mobile: Three columns with 4px gaps and 10px margins; the feature tile spans the full width at the top. Captions stay at 12px but shorten to the name only. The statement sits above at 19px, full width and left-aligned.

references.name: Smallbits
references.idea: The icon set is the page: a full-viewport wall of the product with one docked card holding every word.
references.hero: The whole viewport is a black field tiled with white pixel icons, each drawn about 50px on a 112px pitch, nine rows deep; alternate rows shift half a cell so it reads as a brick pattern, and icons at the edges are cropped. There is no header. A white square-cornered card, 795×170px, is docked bottom-centre: a two-line 24px semibold sentence left, a black rectangular button right, a row of five grey links below. A third-party badge floats top-right. This single screen is the entire page.
references.type: Inter 600 at 24px, -0.02em, for the one sentence; Inter 16px semibold grey for links and button. Nothing exceeds 1.7vw — the pixel icons, not type, are the display element.
references.colour: #000000 #ffffff #9a9a9a #ff6154 — Strict black and white: white icons on black, black text on a white card, grey for secondary links. The only colour is the coral third-party badge.
references.imagery: About ninety visible pixel icons, each an 8×8 bitmap drawn at 50px in pure white with hard edges, tiled full-bleed and cropped at the viewport edges.
references.layout: One viewport, no scroll. A staggered icon grid fills the frame edge to edge; all words live in one docked card. On mobile the card becomes a full-width white block with a full-width button.

sections.description: Mobile restack, the only other state. The icon wall drops to five columns filling the top 73% of the screen; the card becomes a full-width white block at the bottom with the sentence on three lines at 18px, a full-width black button 78px tall, and five grey links spaced evenly on one line.

steal: Make the product the wallpaper: tile the full viewport with the assets at large size and skip a hero image entirely.
Offset alternate rows by half a cell so a regular grid reads as a pattern rather than a table.
Compress all copy, the CTA and the footer links into one docked card so the page never needs to scroll.

references.name: Butter
references.idea: A video editor presented as a bunch of collectable objects: 3D keychain charms in the hero and squircle effect tiles that behave like app icons everywhere else.
references.hero: Soft grey vertical gradient, darker at the top, fading to near-white. Two floating light-grey rounded capsules form the nav: the left holds the script logo, five links and a kebab; the right holds Login and a black button. A 3D bunch of keychain charms (orange carabiner, black letter keycap, chrome ring, magenta disc, steel key, green script tag) hangs from the top edge at centre, overlapping the nav and stopping just above the headline. The headline is one centred line at 7.5vw in regular-weight grotesk spanning 75% of the width, with a 24px sub-line and a black rounded-rectangle button beneath. The bottom 35% is empty.
references.type: DieGrotesk regular at 107px for the one-line headline, near-zero tracking, mixed case; the same face at 24px and 16px below, so a 4.5x then 1.5x step. ABC Diatype for tiny labels inside product panels. The logo is brush-script lettering used as an image.
references.colour: #e8e8e8 #f5f5f5 #1e1e1e #0a0909 #ff3fd8 #19e319 — Grey-to-white ground with black type and black product panels. Saturated colour (magenta, green, orange, holographic pastels) appears only on 3D objects, effect tiles and the footer wordmark.
references.imagery: Live 3D charms with chrome and plastic materials; black editor UI panels with 24px radius; many small squircle video tiles showing halftone, glitch and type-poster effects; a full-width extruded script wordmark.
references.layout: 96px side margins for the nav capsules, a centred content column and very large vertical gaps between blocks. Light grey throughout, with black product panels sliding in from below; ends on a full-bleed wordmark.

sections.description: A single row of seven client logos in black spans the full width, then a long gap, then a centred three-line statement at about 32px, roughly 580px wide, with five small squircle thumbnails (app-icon sized, each a different texture or brand tile) set inline between words like emoji. Words resolve from blurred pale grey to sharp black with scroll, so the last line is still soft and tinted.

A black rounded panel about 690px wide slides up from below: a timeline with timecode, ruler ticks and a track of squircle clips, each clip a vivid texture (halftone horse, glitch stripes, red type poster). One clip is lifted out of the track, enlarged and rotated a few degrees, overlapping the panel's top edge. A second black panel shows a labelled library grid of the same tiles.

Text link columns sit at the top; below them the script wordmark is blown up to the full width and cropped by the bottom edge, drawn in solid black with a thick extruded underside in a holographic pink, blue and cyan gradient and a registered mark at its top right.

steal: Hang a cluster of 3D branded charms from the top edge so it overlaps the nav and points down at a one-line headline.
Set small squircle thumbnails inline between the words of a statement and resolve the words from blurred to sharp on scroll.
End on the script wordmark at full width with a holographic extruded underside, cropped by the bottom edge.
references.media: A 3D keyring about 380x340 hangs from the top edge over the centred headline, about 15% of the fold. After that video is the main medium, 45 muted looping product recordings and client clips in 32px-radius frames: 641px splits alternating sides, a dark app window that pans in from the right in a pinned section, stacked videos swapped by a tab list, and a rail of 9:16 clips bleeding off both edges; no video in the hero.
references.motion: About 2-2.5s of empty grey before the nav, keyring and headline arrive, the headline split into characters that fade and rise. Lenis; one 1800px pinned section slides the statement off left while the app window grows to nearly full width; word spans rise over 0.8s cubic-bezier(0,0,0,1) on 100 elements, four cards stagger in at 0.2-0.5s delays, and the ground steps from #fafafa to #ededed over 1s.

references.name: Le Petit Bleu
references.idea: The cafe's teal-and-white stripes become the whole system: one teal ink on cream, everything boxed in thin double outlines like printed menu cards, beside a permanently visible photo of the room.
references.hero: Viewport split 50/50 with 12px gaps. Left: a cream panel with a thin pale-teal outline and rounded corners. Inside, a second outlined box is the nav bar: two-line hamburger left, teal brush-script logo about 300px wide centred, a caps order link right. Below, a two-line light serif headline at about 3.5vw, centred, in teal, then two centred stacks, each a bold caps label, a serif line and a solid teal button wrapped in a second thin outline. Right: a full-height rounded photo of a striped booth, with an outlined hours bar across its top, three slide dots bottom-left and a white address card bottom-right.
references.type: Self Modern, a light bookish serif, for headline and 15px body; Matter SQ bold caps for labels and buttons; Archive Mono Pro typewriter caps for menu rows; a brush-script logo. Section titles are tall condensed serif caps sized so four to seven letters fill the column.
references.colour: #fcfbf7 #13a7b2 #058599 #cfe5e7 #e9b81f — Cream paper and a single teal used for every word, rule, outline and button; no black anywhere. Yellow, floral reds and marble enter only through the interior photographs.
references.imagery: Bright, saturated interior and food photographs; the right-hand panel is a full-height slideshow with rounded corners. Small food shots sit in a horizontal strip, and a fine line drawing of the shopfront with one teal awning fills a card.
references.layout: The left half scrolls as a stack of outlined cream cards (full-width or two-up) with 12px gaps while the right half stays fixed. Card contents are centred. A sticky nav card rides over the stack. On mobile the photo becomes the hero card's background.

sections.description: A card containing only the section word in tall condensed serif caps, teal, sized so its four letters fill the column edge to edge. Below it, a stack of full-width outlined rows about 36px high, each with a category name in typewriter mono caps at left and a thin plus sign at right, separated by 6px gaps. Above the title: a ticker row of tiny caps and a strip of four small food photos with rounded corners.

The same giant condensed title treatment, then centred serif paragraphs in teal with underlined links in a narrow measure of about 280px. Further down, a landscape photo of the two proprietors with a centred two-line caption in tiny sans, followed by more centred paragraphs. All of it lives in the left half while the right photo panel has advanced to a shelf-wall image.

A header row with a tiny bold caps label at left and a script follow-us link with arrow at right, then three portrait images (about 3:5) with 12px rounded corners in a row, the third cropped by the column edge to imply a carousel. Directly below, the next giant section title begins and is cropped by the viewport.

steal: Print everything in one brand ink on cream, including body text, rules and buttons, and let photographs supply the other colours.
Wrap buttons and panels in a second thin outline offset by a few pixels to get a printed-ticket feel.
Keep a tall photo panel fixed on one half and scroll a stack of cards on the other, swapping the photo as sections change.
